releaseNotes:
Updates in v1.0.4:
- Added Project Summary Reports with visual donut/bar/radar charts, task completion progress rings, and PDF export.
- Integrated Share via Email (PDF attachment) with multi-recipient support.
- Added Multiple Email SMTP Profiles & Step-by-Step Configuration Guide (Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Custom) in Settings.
- Refactored Settings page UI to top tabbed navigation.
